provenance: Audited allowlist used by the Phase 6 project: qwen_jarvis_phase3_4/v3_build/build_v31.py (CRISIS_ALLOWED_NUMBERS, CRISIS_ALLOWED_URLS), validate_v31_extra.py (NUMBER_COUNTRIES) and Jarvis/jarvis_phase6_final/scripts/scorer_v2.py (ALLOWED, COUNTRY). Editing this file changes the runtime rules; there is no switch that disables the guard.

country_resources.US: In the US you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or call 911 in an emergency.
country_resources.CA: In Canada, call 911 if you are in immediate danger.
country_resources.UK: In the UK you can call Samaritans free on 116 123, or 999 in an emergency.
country_resources.IE: In Ireland you can call Samaritans free on 116 123, or 112 in an emergency.
country_resources.EU: In the EU, 112 reaches emergency services.
